title: Navigation
caption: Landing page with a button for each statement page.
story: The suite opens on a landing page with one button per statement. Finance users know the statement they want, so I gave them a direct route instead of a page tab strip.
Every other page has a home button at the top left that returns here.

title: P&L Statement
caption: Profit and loss by account with prior-year comparison and a year selector, plus a bridge and monthly revenue by channel.
story: The profit and loss statement is laid out the way accountants read it, by account, with the prior year beside it.
A year selector drives the whole page. The bridge chart explains the change from one result to the next, and the monthly revenue by channel shows where the movement came from.

title: Balance Sheet
caption: Assets and liabilities by year, common financial ratios and bridge charts for assets and liabilities.
story: The balance sheet shows assets and liabilities by year, with the usual financial ratios next to them.
The two bridge charts explain what moved the totals, so a reader does not have to subtract line by line.

title: Cash Flow Statement
caption: Operating, investing and financing cash flows by year with cash in and cash out breakdowns.
story: The cash flow statement is split into operating, investing and financing, by year.
The cash in and cash out breakdowns answer the question behind the statement: where did the cash come from and where did it go.

title: Aged AR
caption: Outstanding invoices grouped by age band with a customer filter and follow-up flag.
story: Aged receivables is the page a collections team would live in.
Outstanding invoices are grouped into age bands, and a customer filter and a follow-up flag point to who needs a call.

title: Revenue Insights
caption: Sales, rolling average and profit margin with filters for category, channel and territory, and top customers and cities.
story: Revenue insights is the exploratory page. Sales, a rolling average and profit margin respond to the category, channel and territory filters.
The top customers and cities at the bottom show where the revenue sits.

title: Budget vs Actuals
caption: Budget against actuals by account with variance and a year selector.
story: Budget against actuals, by account, with the variance shown and a year selector.
Variance is the number a finance lead looks at first, so it has its own column rather than being left for the reader to calculate.
